snippet.title: Cardboard Cowboy- Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Unfolding the west on KICKSTARTER this summer
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/deddevgames/cardboard-cowboy-a-western-fps-made-of-paper

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3856780/Cardboard_Cowboy/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=Gameplay_Trailer&utm_content=channel_Trailer

Cardboard Cowboy is a first-person shooter set in a Wild West world made entirely out of cardboard. Shoot your way through paper galleries and banditos to unlock more weapons and gear!

Demo out on Steam and will be regularly updated for all our pardners!

Join our Discord and chat about the game or share your best scores
https://discord.gg/sk4ZyFGdjg
